title: Presented permissible coordinate chart ring and labelled boundary equations
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $d\ge0$, $t=(t_i)_{i\in\{1,\ldots,d\}}$ a family in $R$, $J\subseteq\{1,\ldots,d\}$, and $j\in\{1,\ldots,d\}$. In the polynomial ring [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring] $P=R[u_i\mid i\in J\setminus\{j\}]$, put $L=(t_i-t_ju_i\mid i\in J\setminus\{j\})$ and $A_j=P/L$, with its quotient $R$-algebra structure and ratio classes $\bar u_i$. Define $q_i\in A_j$ by $q_j=1$, $q_i=\bar u_i$ for $i\in J\setminus\{j\}$, and $q_i=\bar t_i$ for $i\notin J$. Use labels $\{\ast\}\sqcup\{1,\ldots,d\}$, with equation $e_\ast=\bar t_j$ and $e_i=q_i$. For any subset $I\subseteq\{1,\ldots,d\}$ define the boundary label set $\Lambda(I,j)=\{\ast\}\cup\{i\mid i\in I\setminus\{j\}\}$. For every subset $S$ of the label set define the intersection ideal $(e_k\mid k\in S)$ and the union ideal $\bigcap_{k\in S}(e_k)$ in $A_j$, with empty intersection ideal $0$ and empty union ideal $A_j$. These are just ring and ideal constructions; no regularity or identification with an intrinsic blowup chart is asserted.
